items.rationale: Cause-and-extent inspection is covered under 5.2.6(b), and the €490 estimate follows Case 20 and is below the €3,000 cap. The €500 deductible under 7.8 applies once to the combined event, not separately to each invoice line.
Pinpointing the porous spots is covered under 5.2.6(a). Allow €460 for the survey scope distinct from technician time; the two lines total €635, below their shared €1,000 cap.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers on-site technician time to the extent it is not already included in the leak-detection fee under 7.1.8(c). At €70 gross per hour, 2.5 hours comes to €175 within the shared cap.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on this contractor's invoice. The €76 estimate follows the comparable detection visits and is below the €83.30 gross cap (€70 × 1.19).

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) treats age-related leakage as fracture damage only where leakage is verified, and 9.1.1 does not treat ordinary ageing alone as a duty breach. Allow €260 gross for sealing or locally renewing two joints, excluding the wider pipe replacement and the separately billed van.

Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.5 exclude the remaining run because those sections were not shown to be leaking. If that finding were reversed, €1,600 gross is a rough allowance for like-for-like replacement only.
Section 7.1.9 limits covered repairs to the pre-loss standard, so the standalone premium surcharge has no covered share. The positive figure is a placeholder, not an allowance.

Section 5.2.6(c) allows this plumber's single vehicle charge because the visit included covered joint repairs. Allow €76 gross, below the €83.30 gross cap, with no additional trip for the elective work.
